name: Viral TikTok
about: Fast cuts, big bold captions, punchy pop-up words with whooshes, high contrast, upbeat music if you have some.
about_tl: Mabilis na cuts, malalaking caption, pop-up na salita na may whoosh, matingkad na kulay, masiglang music kung meron ka.
instruction: Hook in the first 2 seconds. Keep it fast; cut every pause.
